# stepcast

> stepcast turns a screen recording into an interactive, click-through product demo (like Storylane or Arcade). It runs entirely in the browser at https://maxgfr.github.io/stepcast/ — no server, no account. This file tells AI agents how to read and write stepcast demos.

## What a demo is

A demo is one JSON document: a list of steps, each showing one screenshot with
a hotspot to click, a tooltip, and optional zoom, highlights, blurs and text
replacements. The JSON Schema is at https://maxgfr.github.io/stepcast/schema.json

Every box is `{ "x", "y", "w", "h" }` normalized to the screenshot: 0–1, origin
at the top-left corner, `x`/`y` being the box's top-left corner.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "title": "Create your first invoice",
  "description": "From draft to sent in four clicks.",
  "language": "en",
  "theme": { "accent": "#6d5efc" },
  "intro": { "title": "Invoices in a minute", "body": "Four clicks, no setup.", "button": "Start" },
  "outro": { "title": "That's it", "body": "", "ctaLabel": "Try it free", "ctaUrl": "https://example.com" },
  "steps": [
    {
      "image": "s1",
      "title": "Open Invoices",
      "body": "Every invoice lives here, sorted by due date.",
      "action": "click",
      "hotspot": { "x": 0.04, "y": 0.21, "w": 0.12, "h": 0.05 },
      "placement": "auto",
      "zoom": { "x": 0, "y": 0.1, "w": 0.5, "h": 0.5 },
      "highlights": [],
      "redactions": [{ "x": 0.8, "y": 0.02, "w": 0.15, "h": 0.04, "style": "blur" }],
      "textEdits": [{ "x": 0.05, "y": 0.02, "w": 0.1, "h": 0.04, "text": "Acme", "bg": "#ffffff", "color": "#111111" }]
    }
  ],
  "images": { "s1": "data:image/png;base64,…" }
}
```

Fields:

- `theme.frame`: null, or a background and window around the screenshots in the player and the videos: `{ "background": "aurora", "padding": 0.06, "radius": 0.012, "shadow": true, "window": "macos" }`. `background` is a gradient (`aurora`, `ocean`, `sunset`, `mint`, `dusk`, `paper`) or a CSS color; `window` is `none` or `macos`.
- `language`: ISO 639-1 code of the texts (`en`, `fr`, `es`, `de`, `it`, `pt`, `nl`, `ru`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `ar`, `hi`, `tr`, `pl`, `sv`); the player's buttons follow it.
- `steps[].image`: a key of `images`; `images` maps keys to `data:` URLs.
- `action`: `click`, `type` (a field to fill) or `look` (nothing to click; `hotspot` null).
- `hotspot`: the element the viewer clicks to go on; null to only look.
- `placement`: where the tooltip goes: `auto`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`.
- `zoom`: the region the camera zooms into (up to 4x), or null.
- `highlights`: regions kept bright while the rest is dimmed.
- `redactions`: regions blurred (`blur`), pixelated (`pixelate`) or covered (`solid`). They are painted into the pixels when the demo is shared or exported.
- `textEdits`: text painted over the screenshot, replacing what it showed.
- Missing fields get defaults; out-of-range boxes are clamped.

## Making a demo as an agent

1. Take screenshots of the product (one per meaningful screen).
2. Write the JSON above, with the screenshots as `data:` URLs in `images`.
3. Save it as a `.json` file. The user opens it from the stepcast home page ("Open a stepcast file"), reviews it, and shares a link or exports HTML, MP4 or GIF.

Good tooltips: title of at most 6 words in the imperative ("Open the billing page"),
body of one or two sentences on why it matters, not only what to click.

## Inside the app

stepcast's own AI mode asks a vision model (the user's key, through llm-connect)
to write the demo with boxes on a 0–1000 scale of each screenshot and a precise
description of every target, then places each box with one small request per
screenshot, and converts them to the 0–1 boxes above. Without a key, the same prompt and a picture of the
screenshots can be pasted into any chat app, and the JSON answer pasted back.

## Share links

`https://maxgfr.github.io/stepcast/#/play/<bundle>` plays a demo carried in the
link. The bundle is `"SCB1"`, a little-endian u32 manifest length, the manifest
JSON (`{ demo, assets: [{ key, type, size }] }`), then the image bytes back to
back; the whole buffer is compressed with deflate-raw and encoded as base64url.
`#/gist/<id>` plays a bundle stored in a GitHub Gist (file `stepcast-demo.txt`).
Replace `#/play/` or `#/gist/` with `#/embed/` or `#/embed/gist/` for an iframe.

Source: https://github.com/maxgfr/stepcast
